disclaimer.title: Important Disclaimer
disclaimer.text: This app provides general nutritional information and is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult with a healthcare provider before making significant changes to your diet, especially if you have any health conditions or concerns.

warnings.fiber_too_low: Fiber intake is below recommended levels. Consider increasing your intake of low-FODMAP fruits, vegetables, and gluten-free grains.
warnings.protein_too_low: Protein intake is below recommended levels. Consider adding more protein sources to your meals.
warnings.fat_too_low: Fat intake is below recommended levels. Healthy fats are important for hormone production and nutrient absorption.
warnings.calcium_too_low: Calcium intake is below recommended levels. Consider calcium-rich, low-FODMAP foods or supplements if needed.
warnings.iron_too_low: Iron intake is below recommended levels. Consider iron-rich foods and vitamin C to enhance absorption.
warnings.vitamin_d_too_low: Vitamin D intake is below recommended levels. Consider supplementation, especially if you have limited sun exposure.
warnings.water_too_low: Water intake is below recommended levels. Proper hydration is essential for digestive health.
warnings.fiber_too_high: Fiber intake is above recommended levels. Too much fiber can cause digestive discomfort in some individuals.
warnings.protein_too_high: Protein intake is above recommended levels. Excessive protein may strain kidneys in susceptible individuals.
warnings.fat_too_high: Fat intake is above recommended levels. High fat intake can slow digestion and worsen symptoms.
warnings.sodium_too_high: Sodium intake is above recommended levels. High sodium can increase blood pressure and fluid retention.
warnings.sugar_too_high: Sugar intake is above recommended levels. Limit added sugars for better health outcomes.
